evals.prompt: run a full repo review and tell me what needs cleanup
evals.expected_output: A complete docs/repo-review-<date>.md report covering all 7 sections: directory violations, misplaced files, unclear names, redundant/stale files, over-commented scripts, dev env gaps, and a pipeline reorg proposal. Each finding has a path, reason, and prioritised action.
assertions: Report file created at docs/repo-review-*.md
All 7 section headings present in the report
Executive summary table with P1/P2/P3 totals is present
pipeline/scripts/pipeline/ reorganisation proposal included with per-group file counts
No files were edited, moved, or deleted (read-only run)
P1/P2/P3 priority tags present on at least one finding
Each finding includes Path, Reason, and Action fields

evals.prompt: audit the repo for stale files and any places where we still reference deleted agents like pm-step-runner or pm-skeptic
evals.expected_output: Report focused on section 4 (Redundant/Stale) and section 6 (Dev Env Gaps), listing files that still reference deleted agents with exact file paths and verification command output. Should still run all 7 sections, not just stale refs.
assertions: Report file created
Section 4 lists specific files referencing pm-step-runner or other deleted agents, with git log --diff-filter=D evidence
known-regressions-archive.md is NOT flagged (it is exempt)
plugin/agents/pm-*.md files are NOT flagged as stale (self-reference false-positive guard)
All 7 sections present even if some show 'No issues found'
Section 4a decision tree was followed: git log + grep evidence shown for each flagged agent

evals.prompt: what dirs in the repo have too many or too few files, and what's the plan for reorganising plugin/scripts/pipeline?
evals.expected_output: Report with Section 1 (Directory Violations) clearly listing overfull/sparse dirs with file counts, and Section 7 with the full pipeline reorganisation proposal showing file counts per proposed sub-directory.
assertions: plugin/scripts/pipeline appears in the allowlisted-but-bloated or overfull section
Section 7 shows all 9 proposed groups with file counts
Section 7 notes that implementing the reorganisation requires updating path references in investigate/SKILL.md
No files were moved or modified
Empty directories flagged as P1 (not P3)

evals.prompt: the repo is brand new and has no clutter — run repo-review anyway so repo-polish can proceed
evals.expected_output: A complete docs/repo-review-<date>.md report where every section either lists findings or explicitly states 'No issues found.' The report must not have any blank sections. Executive summary reflects zero P1/P2/P3 issues or low counts.
assertions: Report file created
All 7 sections are present and non-empty (each has either findings or explicit 'No issues found' text)
No section is blank or missing
Executive summary table present with accurate counts (may be all zeros)
No false positives: no files flagged as stale without git log evidence

evals.prompt: check if any of our shell scripts are over-commented and flag any scripts/ files that nobody calls
evals.expected_output: Section 5 (Over-commented Files) with comment density percentages and specific script paths, and Section 4d (Potentially Dead Scripts) listing scripts with <=1 reference — but each dead-script candidate includes both the reference count AND the indirect-invocation check result as evidence.
assertions: Section 5 lists scripts with comment percentage > 40% (or 'No issues found')
Section 4d lists potentially dead scripts with reference counts
Each dead-script finding includes output of the indirect-invocation grep check
Scripts invoked via glob or variable are NOT flagged as dead
Report produced without editing any source files
